q: What are the emissions from combine harvesting per acre?
title: Combine harvester: CO2 per acre
short: Multiply diesel per acre by 2.68 kg CO2 per litre. Owners report it in Scope 1. Farmers who hire a harvester count it in Scope 3, from the hire invoice. Diesel per acre varies with crop, yield and field size, so measure it from fill-ups over a season.
audience: Farmers, custom hire operators and agri buyers

ol: Fill the tank fully before and after a set of fields.

p: For a crop footprint, harvesting is one item alongside fertiliser, irrigation and residue burning, which is often larger.

example.title: Worked example (illustrative)
example.note: Illustrative figure only. Measure your own litres per acre.

senseible: Senseible reads fuel invoices and electricity bills and applies IPCC 2006 factors and the CEA grid factor (0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25), so you can compare Scope 1 and 2 before and after a change from the documents themselves.
